run_microbenchmark_all_collectors: run all microbenchmark collectors (latency, perf, summary) against available benchmarks using the CLI script
run_collect_latency: run the latency profile collector to generate latency trace files and analysis reports for a benchmark
run_collect_perf: run the perf collector to generate flamegraph SVGs from perf recording data for a benchmark
run_collect_summary: run the summary collector to generate JSON benchmark summary output with and without counters
run_fnize: run the fnize function to sanitize benchmark test names by replacing special characters with underscores
